"Title" field in .sym files not processed
One of my use cases is to read .sym files modify them in python and then to export them again. The title field is written by PCAN symbol editor and I think it makes sense to have it be preserved if the file if read and then written back to file.

To start solving this issue, we need to understand the format of the .sym files and how they are being read and written by the existing code. The issue text mentions the "Title" field, which suggests that there is a specific field in the .sym file format that is not being processed correctly.
